subject: creative_writing

resources.title: Introduction to Fiction
resources.notes: Communications-intensive fiction course requiring polished writing and revision; useful for narrative craft and revision evidence.

resources.title: Reading Poetry
resources.notes: Formal tools include meter, sound, syntax, word choice, metaphor, rhythm, analytic writing and revision.

resources.title: Playwriting I
resources.notes: Craft-focused theater writing with scene structure, action, events, voice, dialogue, weekly exercises and a sustained project.

resources.title: Writing and Reading the Essay
resources.notes: Writing-centered study of the literary essay and nonfiction prose with assignment examples.

resources.title: Forms of Western Narrative
resources.notes: Studies changing narrative forms and how historical, cultural and technological contexts shape storytelling.

resources.title: Project Gutenberg Literature Corpus
resources.notes: Primary-text corpus for reading, comparison and craft analysis; individual editions remain provenance-tracked.

resources.title: Computational Creativity and Writing Research
resources.notes: Research layer only; individual papers require relevance, quality and license review before ingestion.

known_gaps: Dedicated screenwriting curricula remain thinner than fiction and playwriting coverage.
Graduate-level workshop and publishing-practice coverage needs stronger open, directly auditable curricula rather than being inferred from undergraduate courses.
Research repositories do not establish expert creative-writing readiness without portfolio work, iterative critique, revision evidence and assessment.
